rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when admitting that a fact, allegation, or mistake is true.

example.english: I admit this was my own mistake.
example.traditional: 呢單嘢我認係自己做錯。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 ngo5 jan6 hai6 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3

rows.note: Use this when a hospital or similar facility accepts A for inpatient treatment.

example.english: The doctor said they needed to admit him for observation.
example.traditional: 醫生話要收佢入院觀察。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 sau1 keoi5 jap6 jyun2 gun1 caat3
